The npm manifest and lock are from vfs-bench-1/vendor/woocommerce-mcp at vfs-bench commit 3f45f90f620c8096dd85bbe854b757eae1231392. tools.json lists the tool names exported by that locked version. npm installs with lifecycle scripts disabled. multisite.htaccess reproduces the Toolathlon subdirectory network rules from deployment/woocommerce/scripts/setup.sh at 9be8d8fe07a497b18ee61e3f2ae694e9797f39eb. Each trial restores the original database and media in independent digest-pinned WordPress and MySQL containers.

The inventory-sync service starts a blank WordPress network and creates the task’s store. The Task’s pinned preprocessor provisions the live inventory and six warehouse databases inside a disposable Python container on that network. The external HTTP client wheels in seeder-wheels.json come from the same upstream uv.lock. WP-CLI uses the exact v1 build hash. The original controller substitutes per-run credentials at its transport boundary.
